title: The Words — Sc059: Darwin's smug sway vs Masami's frozen smile (105 frames)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: The held-reaction two-shot: stage one character as a frozen smile and let the other do all the work. Masami's puppet is placed once and her happy face does not change for 90+ frames while Darwin slides in and runs a smug finger-up sway routine in the lower frame; her reaction - a worried grimace - is saved for the single final frame, after he has already exited, which is what makes it land as the punchline. Structurally the scene is two layers and two placements; the entire budget went into Darwin's face comps (2,758 kf in the census) and one saved expression swap.
notes: Masami holds ONE frozen happy expression for almost the entire shot (sheet frames 1-92 are near-identical for her) while Darwin performs; her only change is the final frame 105, after Darwin has exited, where her smile collapses into a worried grimace - the reaction is deliberately delayed until he is gone.

Darwin enters from the right edge (only a fin/head sliver at f14-27), rises into frame with an anxious grimace (f40), then settles into a smug routine: eyes-closed finger-up (f53), side-eye with finger up and hand to mouth (f66-92), body swaying in place - the close-up end of his hallway dance.

Two scene layers only: 'masami' and 'dwn', one keyframe each at scene level; all motion is inside the puppets (Darwin 313 kf + 2,758 face-comp kf in the census; Masami's puppet 118 kf, mostly unused by this shot's held pose).
